name: Deploy Beta

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches:
      - master

# Ensures that only one deploy task per branch/environment will run at a time.
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: beta
      url: https://beta.dim.gg
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 2 # So sentry can get the previous commit

      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-pnpm

      - name: Install SSH key
        uses: benoitchantre/setup-ssh-authentication-action@1.0.1
        with:
          private-key: ${{ secrets.SSH_KEY }}
          private-key-name: dim.rsa
          known-hosts: ${{ secrets.REMOTE_HOST }}

      - name: Get package version
        id: package-version
        uses: martinbeentjes/npm-get-version-action@v1.3.1

      - name: Set beta environment
        run: |
          echo "build_level='beta'" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Bump release version (beta)
        env:
          RUN_NUM: ${{ github.run_number }}
        run: |
          echo "VERSION=${{ steps.package-version.outputs.current-version }}.$(($RUN_NUM))" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Build
        run: pnpm build:beta
        env:
          NODE_OPTIONS: "--max_old_space_size=8192"
          WEB_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.BUNGIE_API_KEY }}
          WEB_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID: ${{ secrets.OAUTH_CLIENT_ID }}
          WEB_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET: ${{ secrets.OAUTH_SECRET }}
          DIM_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.DIM_API_KEY }}

      - name: Send bundle stats to RelativeCI
        uses: relative-ci/agent-action@v3
        with:
          key: ${{ secrets.RELATIVE_CI_KEY }}
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          webpackStatsFile: ./webpack-stats.json

      - name: Check Syntax
        run: pnpm syntax

      - name: Rsync to Server
        run: ./build/rsync-deploy.sh
        env:
          SSH_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.SSH_KEY }}
          SOURCE: "dist/"
          REMOTE_USER: ${{ secrets.REMOTE_USER }}
          REMOTE_HOST: ${{ secrets.REMOTE_HOST }}
          REMOTE_PATH: beta.destinyitemmanager.com

      - name: Purge CloudFlare cache
        run: ./build/purge-cloudflare.sh
        env:
          CLOUDFLARE_KEY: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_KEY }}
          CLOUDFLARE_EMAIL: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_EMAIL }}
          APP_DOMAIN: beta.destinyitemmanager.com

      - name: Create Sentry release
        uses: getsentry/action-release@v3
        env:
          SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN }}
          SENTRY_ORG: destiny-item-manager
          SENTRY_PROJECT: dim
        with:
          environment: beta
          release: ${{ env.VERSION }}
          ignore_missing: true

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
